speech_en: I cannot travel through the air — and a vaccine stops me!
speech_de: Durch die Luft komme ich nicht — und eine Impfung stoppt mich!
scenario: A friendly noodle-shaped Ebola character - one long even-width ribbon with its head end curled into a shepherd's crook, a big happy face on the curl and two little waving arms - lounging in a sunny forest clearing far from any town. With it: a cheerful fruit bat hanging upside down from a branch (the animal it normally lives with), a smiling doctor in a coat holding up a huge vaccine bottle, and a clipboard with big empty tick boxes for the contact list. Playful and reassuring: nobody is ill, nothing is frightening, and the picture shows how outbreaks are stopped rather than what the virus does.
command: uv run --script .claude/skills/microbe-render/scripts/coloring.py --microbe ebola-virus --set pathogens-viruses --prompt-file <this prompt> --model <model> --attempt N --speech-en "I cannot travel through the air — and a vaccine stops me!" --speech-de "Durch die Luft komme ich nicht — und eine Impfung stoppt mich!"
prompt:
A black-and-white CHILDREN'S COLORING BOOK page, square 1:1, 1080x1080.

SCENE: A big friendly cartoon EBOLA VIRUS character lounging in a sunny FOREST CLEARING, drawn ZOOMED IN and very large so the scene runs past every edge of the square. The virus is a LONG SMOOTH NOODLE - one single ribbon of exactly the same width all along, like a thick piece of rope or a garden hose - that lies diagonally across the whole picture from the lower right up to the upper left. Its upper end CURLS BACK ON ITSELF INTO A BIG ROUND HOOK like a shepherd's crook, and that curled end is its HEAD: a BIG FRIENDLY FACE with two large round eyes with pupils, cheerful curved eyebrows and a wide happy grin. Two little stubby arms stick out of the noodle, one of them waving. A row of small evenly spaced rounded BUMPS runs along both sides of the whole noodle like the studs on a rubber mat. Its lower end runs off the bottom-right edge of the picture.
Around it in the same clearing: a cheerful cartoon FRUIT BAT with big round ears and a happy grin hanging upside down by its feet from a thick tree branch that enters from the top left and crosses behind the virus; a smiling cartoon DOCTOR in a long coat standing on the right, holding up a HUGE vaccine bottle with a big rounded label patch left completely blank, and tucking a clipboard with three big empty square tick boxes under the other arm; and a few very large simple leaves and rounded bushes filling the corners, with the grassy ground running off the bottom and both sides. Everything is drawn large, simple and chunky so a child can colour inside every shape. The mood is playful and reassuring - everybody is smiling, nobody is ill, nothing is frightening.

STYLE - coloring book line art:
- BOLD, THICK, EVEN BLACK OUTLINES on pure WHITE. Every shape fully closed.
- ABSOLUTELY NO shading, NO grey tones, NO hatching, NO stippling, NO cross-hatching, NO gradients, NO colour fill, NO solid black areas anywhere (eyes may have a small solid pupil only).
- Simple, cheerful, chunky cartoon shapes with generous white space inside them.

STRICTLY FORBIDDEN - the page is rejected if any of these appear:
- ANY decorative STARBURST, comic-style radiating burst, "pow"/impact star, sparkle burst, twinkle burst, sunbeam rays, radiating speed lines or halo of rays behind, around or under the character. No radiating lines of any kind. They leave a big empty shape that cannot be removed afterwards.
- ANY rectangle, rounded rectangle, square box outline, picture frame, panel edge, comic panel, border line, outer margin line, ground-line box or vignette. The drawing must NOT sit inside a box of any kind.
- The artwork must BLEED OFF the bottom, left and right edges of the square - the ground, the bushes, the branch and the virus noodle run right off those edges with no white margin band and no enclosing outline.
- NO text, letters, numbers, words, captions, labels, signatures or watermarks anywhere - the bottle label and the clipboard boxes stay completely blank.
- NO speech bubble, thought bubble or balloon of any kind (one is added separately afterwards).
- NO blood, no wounds, no bandages, no rash, no spots on anybody, no thermometers, no sick or sad or frightened faces, no hospital beds, no hazmat suits, no masks, no biohazard signs, no warning triangles, no skulls.
- NO spikes, rays, tails, wings or legs on the virus beyond the two little stubby arms, and its noodle body never gets thicker or thinner along its length.
